description.name: Basic Attack: Thornbreaker
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Lindverne performs up to 4 consecutive attacks forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
Repeatedly press or hold during the 4th attack to perform an extended slash against enemies.
When the heavy attack of the 4th attack hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>[Gash]</color>, consume all <color=#FFFFFF>[Gash]</color> stacks on the target, up to 3 stacks. For each <color=#FFFFFF>[Gash]</color> stack consumed, trigger <color=#FFFFFF>[Maim]</color> on the target once, dealing additional AoE <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th attack.
During the 3rd and 4th attacks, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

description.name: Basic Attack: Bannerbearer
Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge
description.desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>[Kinetic Energy]</color> is sufficient, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Switch to Eldreda and launch an attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dodge: Phase Fold
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Lindverne performs a quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dash Attack: Void Slash Rush
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Lindverne slashes forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Smoldering Fire Reignition
description.desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>[Perfect Dodge]</color> is triggered, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Lindverne unleashes a consecutive attack forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
After using this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to quickly chain into the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack]</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dodge: Spatial Reconstruction
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Eldreda performs a quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dash Attack: Reality Reversal
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Eldreda thrusts forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge: Patrol
description.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> while moving the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to activate:
Eldreda enters the <color=#FFFFFF>[Nightglide]</color> state, allowing high-speed movement.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>[Nightglide]</color> state, use the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to control direction. Release the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to stop.
Character is invulnerable at the moment this skill activates.

description.name: Dash Attack: Patrol - Shadow Realm Raid
description.desc:
In <color=#FFFFFF>[Nightglide]</color> state, Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Eldreda unleashes a quick Tail Swipe attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Cold Flame Returning Edge
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Eldreda launches consecutive attacks forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
After using this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.desc:

description.name: EX Special Attack: Night Blaze - Dawnrise
description.desc:
When Sharpness is sufficient, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Ep> to activate:
Lindverne and Eldreda launch a Synergy attack, keeping Lindverne on the field and dealing <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>[Gash]</color>, consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>[Gash]</color> stacks on the target, up to 3 stacks. For each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>[Gash]</color> consumed, triggers <color=#FFFFFF>[Maim]</color> once on the target, dealing additional AoE <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Night Blaze - Dawnborn (Modified)
description.desc:
When Sharpness is sufficient, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Ep> after the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Thornbreaker]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Dodge Counter: Smoldering Fire Reignition]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Assist Follow-Up: Undying Passion]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Ultimate: "This Wish, Reshape All Things"]</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack: Lantern - Dusk's End (Modified)]</color> to activate:
Lindverne and Eldreda launch a coordinated attack, keeping Lindverne on the field and dealing <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>[Gash]</color>, it consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>[Gash]</color> stacks on the target, up to a max of 3 stacks. For each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>[Gash]</color> consumed, triggers <color=#FFFFFF>[Maim]</color> on the target once, dealing additional AoE <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Ultimate: "Onward, Together"
description.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Lindverne launches a Coordinated Attack with Eldreda and Dracaene and remains on the field, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
While holding <color=#FFFFFF>Flag Order</color>, consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Flag Order</color> and converts it into <color=#FFFFFF>Wish Core</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Chain Attack: In the Name of Sunbringer
Ultimate: "By This Wish, All Things Remade"
description.desc:
When Eldreda has <color=#FFFFFF>[Wish Core]</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Eldreda warps space in mid-air to attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color> and removing all <color=#FFFFFF>[Ember Scar]</color> from enemies.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Chain Attack: Building Dreams for All
Chain Attack: In the Name of Sunbringer
Ultimate: "By This Wish, All Things Remade"
Quick Assist: Dauntless Aid
description.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Lindverne unleashes a consecutive attack forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
After using this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to quickly chain into the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack]</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Quick Assist: Path of the Gleaming Edge
description.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Eldreda unleashes a flurry of consecutive attacks forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
After activating this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to chain into the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack]</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist: Oath of Steadfastness
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dracaene parries the enemy's attack, accumulating massive Daze.
When Lindverne or Eldreda is on field, this skill can also be activated by switching in the next character.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Counter Assist: Fortress of Hope
Assist Follow-Up: Lighthouse, Towering in the Sky
description.desc:
After activating a <color=#FFFFFF>[Counter Assist]</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Dracaene unleashes an attack dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>. When the heavy attack hits an enemy, it directly applies 1 stack of [Gash] to the target.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Undying Passion
Assist Follow-Up: Faith Unwavering
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after Dracaene activates a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Eldreda unleashes a swift forward slash, followed by an explosion that deals <color=#FF5521>Genesis Flare DMG</color>.
After using this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to chain into the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive:
Additional Ability:
desc:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>[Stun]</color> Character, <color=#FFFFFF>[Defense]</color> Character, or <color=#FFFFFF>[Armorer]</color> Character:
When Sunbringer uses <color=#FFFFFF>[Dash Attack: Eldreda - Roaming Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack: Eldreda - Mid-Tier Switch-In]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack: Lindverne - Mid-Tier Switch-In]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack: Lindverne - High-Tier Switch-In]</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack: Lindverne - High-Tier Switch-In]</color>, all <color=#FFFFFF>[Armorer]</color> Agents in the whole squad enter the <color=#FFFFFF>[Laceration Enhance]</color> state. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>[Laceration Enhance]</color> state, Laceration DMG increases by <color=#FFFFFF>25%</color> for 45s. Re-entering the <color=#FFFFFF>[Laceration Enhance]</color> state refreshes the duration.
